title: Reasons to stay natural: PEDs will have you chasing the dragon
summary: He argues PED use follows an addiction pattern ('chasing the dragon'): everyone starts promising just one or two light cycles, but since more drugs always means more growth, use escalates to high doses that wreck health, even among ordinary guys who will never go pro. He contrasts this with the healthy natural feedback loop and states that promoting natural bodybuilding is the channel's creed.

claims.claim: People start PEDs to get faster or better results, to put in less effort (rarely admitted), or because they think they've hit their natural limit.
Everyone he's known who used PEDs started by telling themselves it would be one or two cycles or low doses; nobody starts out planning heavy use, yet many end up there.
He doesn't believe old-school pro bodybuilders who claim they took almost nothing; he thinks they lie about dosages and that use was always heavy.
The natural feedback loop is healthy: you see growth from an exercise or diet and keep doing it. The enhanced loop is to take more because more drugs always gives more results, which never ends.
PEDs have diminishing returns at some point, but most users aren't wise enough to see it and keep escalating.
PED use becomes chasing the illusion that the next cycle will finally bring the size that makes you happy, which never happens.
It's easy to find young guys on YouTube who've been on drugs for years, will never go pro or make money, don't even look that good, yet take huge amounts and destroy their health.
Once someone is deep into PEDs and in love with the results, arguments no longer get through, so his goal is to make sure viewers never start.
The channel's first purpose is promoting natural bodybuilding and guiding younger lifters; he doesn't claim to know more, only that he started earlier and has seen what to prevent.
Promises like 'just one or two light cycles' or 'I'll respect PCT' are lies naturals tell themselves to quiet the guilt of starting; the more you take, the more you want.
